segments.name: Toy and Souvenir
segments.description: Designs, develops and manufactures custom toys and souvenirs for the world's largest theme parks and entertainment venues.
segments.evidence: The Company is a trusted toy and souvenir designer and developer, selling into the world's largest theme parks and entertainment venues.

revenueModel.text: Theme parks, entertainment venues and retailers pay the company for its custom toys, souvenirs and pop culture merchandise.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable are generated from sales of the Company's products.

changes.text: In 2025 the company changed its name from SRM Entertainment, Inc. to Tron Inc. and adopted a TRX token treasury strategy.
changes.evidence: Tron Inc. (formerly SRM Entertainment, Inc.), is a publicly traded company pioneering blockchain-integrated treasury strategies.
